## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/AntiFreeze-1/badge-arcade-server-full/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#rules-that-keep-installs-working) for why these matter.

- [ ] No Nintendo files, keys or dumps are included
- [ ] `Setup.bat` and `Badge Arcade Manager.bat` are unchanged
- [ ] No folder or file people keep their own files in has moved (a new one is in both `.gitignore` and `PROTECTED` in `update.py`)
- [ ] If installs should get this, `version.txt` and `VERSION` are both raised
